rule.description: A rendering-pipeline driver function embeds the copied and adapted implementations of three or more former call levels of its sub-method tree directly in its own body, collapsing the decomposition into one extremely large and deeply nested function.

checks.description: Flag driver functions in the library scope (chafa/*.c and chafa/internal/*.c) whose bodies exceed 240 statements or a cognitive complexity of 120, the signature of a sub-method tree that has been collapsed into one function.
checks.detected_relation: driver function -> inlined former sub-method implementations (3+ former call levels embedded)
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Each driver previously delegated to a call tree of named sub-methods; after the sub-method bodies are copied into the driver, the driver exceeds any reasonable single-function size and complexity, so measurable size/complexity is the observable surface of the destroyed decomposition.

matches.evidence: Driver of symbol selection cells; formerly delegated through update_cell, pick_symbol_and_colors_slow/fast, eval_symbol, eval_symbol_colors, eval_symbol_error, update_cell_colors, apply_fill and apply_fill_fg_only; all embedded bodies now execute inline in the row loop.
Public emit entry point; formerly returned build_ansi_gstring's result, which delegated to build_ansi_row and the emit_ansi_* per-mode helpers; the whole formatting pipeline is now one function.
Palette creation driver; formerly forwarded to chafa_palette_generate_bgfg, chafa_palette_generate_fixed, and chafa_palette_generate_dynamic sub-branches whose bodies are now embedded.

Symbol map preparation driver; formerly delegated through process_symbol_file and per-format parse helpers whose copied bodies (comment stripping, unidata special-casing, JSON and plain-text parsing) now run inline.

excluded.reason: Unmodified sibling row driver for the wide-symbol family; it keeps its own shared helper calls and stays within both thresholds.

Emitter primitives such as flush_chars, queue_char, reset_attributes, reset_fg_color_bg_color and prealloc_string intentionally remain as shared called helpers of the printing pipeline; their existence does not reduce the matched drivers to pre-injection size.
Unmodified sibling public entry point that still delegates through chafa_canvas_print_symbols_array's own helper chain; not part of the injected locations.
